name: MySQL Query Environment
postCreateCommand: until mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -u vscode --password=password --silent; do sleep 1; done && mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -u vscode --password=password mydatabase -e 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255)); INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ("Alice"), ("Bob");' && echo 'MySQL initialized.'
